PRELIMINARY NOTIFICATION

In exercise of the powers conferred by Section 5 of the Karnataka Land Revenue
Act, 1964 (Karnataka act no 12 of 1964) and taking into consideration the factors
specified in clause (i) to (iv) of rule 3 of the Karnataka Land Revenue Rules 1966 such
as the population , area under land revenue and having regard to the administrative
convenience, the Government of Karnataka proposes to alter the extent of residential
area by adding an area occupied by unrecorded habitation within the boundary of
Ajjavara village in Nandi Hobli of Chikkaballapura Taluk, Chikkaballapura
District to extend the original gramatana extent of the existing revenue village. The
area occupied by the said village is specified in the schedule below.
Notification is hereby issued that Land bearing survey numbers and extent
specified in schedule shall be declared as habitation area within the boundary of
Ajjavara village for extension of original gramatana extent of the said revenue village.
Now therefore in exercise of the powers conferred by section 6 of the said Act,
notice is hereby given for the information of all the persons likely to be affected
thereby that the proposal will be taken into consideration after seven days from the
date of publication of the notification in the official Gazette.
Any objection or suggestion which may be received by the State Government
from any persons with respect to the said proposal before the expiry of period
specified above will be considered by the State Government. Objections or suggestion
may be addressed to the Deputy Commissioner, Chikkballapura district.

SCHEDULE

Land bearing survey numbers in column (2) and extent specified below in
column(3) of the table shall be declared as habitation area of Ajjavara village of
Chikkaballpura taluk of Chikkaballpura district and convert the same to form
habitation extension within the boundary of Ajjavara Revenue village and same will
be named as part of original gramatana extent of Ajjavara village Chikkaballpura
Taluk, Chikkaballpura District.

Hereby declared that the extent of land indicated in the column(3) above with
survey numbers specified in column(2) in which the said unrecorded habitation is
located is proposed to be extended as part of original gramatana extent, habitation
area (Gramatana), of Ajjavara village of Nandi Hobli, Chikkaballapura Taluk of
Chikkaballapura District.

The proposal specified above shall come in to effect from the date of its final
notification to be published in the official gazette by the state Government under
section5 of the Karnatanka Land Revenue Act,1964(Karnataka Act 12 of 1964)

By Order and in the name of the
Governor of Karnataka

RD 25 PFH 2023 Karnataka Government Secretariat
Multi Storied Building
Bengaluru, Date:06-03-2023

PRELIMINARY NOTIFICATION

In exercise of the powers conferred by Section 5 of the Karnataka Land Revenue
Act 1964 (Karnataka act no 12 of 1964) and taking into consideration the factors
specified in clauses (i) to (iv) of rule 3 of the Karnataka Land Revenue Rules 1966
such as the population, area of the village the demand under land revenue in the village
and other head of the account and having regard to the administrative convenience the
Government of Karnataka proposes to issue a Notification to alter the limits of
Ajjipura Village of Hanuru talluk Chamarajanagara District and to constitute a
new revenue village called Dommanagadde, Nagannanagara as specified in
schedule along with maps with old survey numbers and new assigned to them.

Now, therefore in exercise of the power conferred by section 6 of the said Act,
notice is hereby given for the information of all the persons likely to be affected

thereby that the proposal will be taken into consideration on or after thirty days from
the date of publication of the notification in the official Gazette.

Any objection or suggestion which may be received by the state Government
from any person with respect to the said proposal before the date specified above will
be considered by the state Government. Objections or suggestion may be addressed to
the Deputy Commissioner, Chamarajanagara District, Chamarajanagara

SCHEDULE-1

Land bearing survey numbers of the village and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of said
village Ajjipura of Hanuru taluk in Chamarajanagara District to form a new
revenue village called Dommanagadde of Hanuru taluk Chamarajanagara district
along with the survey numbers included in column (4) thereof.

PRELIMINARY NOTIFICATION
In exercise of the powers conferred by Section 5 of the Karnataka Land Revenue
Act, 1964 (Karnataka act no 12 of 1964) and taking into consideration the factors
specified in clause (i) to (iv) of rule 3 of the Karnataka Land Revenue Rules 1966 such
as the population , area under land revenue and having regard to the administrative
convenience, the Government of Karnataka proposes to alter the extent of residential
area by adding an area occupied by unrecorded habitation within the boundary of
Beedaganahalli village in Nandi Hobli of Chikkaballapura Taluk,
Chikkaballapura District to extend the original gramatana extent of the existing
revenue village. The area occupied by the said village is specified in the schedule
below.
Notification is hereby issued that Land bearing survey numbers and extent
specified in schedule shall be declared as habitation area within the boundary of

Beedaganahalli village for extension of original gramatana extent of the said
revenue village.
Now therefore in exercise of the powers conferred by section 6 of the said Act,
notice is hereby given for the information of all the persons likely to be affected
thereby that the proposal will be taken into consideration after thirty days from the
date of publication of the notification in the official Gazette.
Any objection or suggestion which may be received by the State Government
from any persons with respect to the said proposal before the expiry of period
specified above will be considered by the State Government. Objections or suggestion
may be addressed to the Deputy Commissioner, Chikkballapura district.
SCHEDULE

Land bearing survey numbers in column (2) and extent specified below in
column(3) of the table shall be declared as habitation area of Beedaganahalli village
of Chikkaballpura taluk of Chikkaballpura district and convert the same to form

FINAL NOTIFICATION
Whereas the draft of the Notification No. RD 51 PFH 2022 Dated:05-12-2022
regarding altering the limits of Doddabyagathavalli village of Holenarasipura
Taluk and Hassan District and constituting a new revenue village called Kallikoppalu
was published as required by section 6 of the Karnataka Land Revenue Act, 1964

(Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) in the Karanataka Gazette No. dated:06-12-2022
inviting objections or suggestions from all the persons likely to be affected thereby
within thirty days from the date of its publication in the Official Gazette.

And whereas, the said gazette was made available to the public on Dated
06-12-2022

the State Government;

Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) the Government of Karnataka here
by makes the following notification, namely:-

specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of said
village Doddabyagathavalli of Holenarasipura taluk, District to form a new revenue
village called Kallikoppalu of Holenarasipura taluk Hassan district along with
survey numbers included in column (4) thereof.

PRELIMINARY NOTIFICATION
In exercise of the powers conferred by Section 5 of the Karnataka Land
Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act no 12 of 1964) and taking in to consideration the
factors specified in clauses (I) to (Iv) of rule 3 of the Karnataka Land Revenue Rules
1966 such as the populations, area of the village, the demand under Land Revenue in
the village and having regard to the administrative convenience and in supersession of
notification No. RD 69 BHUDAPU 2001 Bangalore, Dated 12th December, 2003
published in part IV-A of the Karnataka Gazette No. 1637 dated 12th December 2003,
the Government of Karnataka proposes to issue a notification to alter the limits of
Kumbaraghatta village of Arasikere Taluk, Hassan district and to constitute a new
village called Ranganathapura as specified in schedule along with maps with old
survey numbers and new survey numbers assigned to them.

Now therefore in exercise of the power conferred by section 6 of the said Act
notice is hereby given for the information of all the persons likely to be affected
thereby that the proposal will be taken in to consideration on or after thirty days from
the date of publication of the notification in the official Gazette.

Any objection or suggestion which may be received by the state government
from any person with respect to the said proposal before the date specified above will
be considered by the state government. Objections or suggestions may be addressed to
the Deputy Commissioner, Hassan district Hassan.

SCHEDULE-1
Lands bearing survey numbers of the village and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of said
Kumbaraghatta village of Arasikere Taluk in Hassan Disrict to form a new revenue
village called Ranganathapura as of Arasikere taluk and Hassan district along with
the survey numbers included in column (4) thereof.

PRELIMINARY NOTIFICATION

In exercise of the powers conferred by Section 5 of the Karnataka Land Revenue
Act, 1964 (Karnataka act no 12 of 1964) and taking into consideration the factors
specified in clause (i) to (iv) of rule 3 of the Karnataka Land Revenue Rules 1966 such
as the population , area under land revenue and having regard to the administrative
convenience, the Government of Karnataka proposes to alter the extent of residential
area by adding an area occupied by unrecorded habitation within the boundary of
Marimakalahalli village in Manchenahalli Hobli of Gauribidanur Taluk,
Chikkaballapura District to extend the original gramatana extent of the existing
revenue village. The area occupied by the said village is specified in the schedule
below.
Notification is hereby issued that Land bearing survey numbers and extent
specified in schedule shall be declared as habitation area within the boundary of
Marimakalahalli village for extension of original gramatana extent of the said
revenue village.
Now therefore in exercise of the powers conferred by section 6 of the said Act,
notice is hereby given for the information of all the persons likely to be affected

thereby that the proposal will be taken into consideration after Seven days from the date of
publication of the notification in the official Gazette.
Any objection or suggestion which may be received by the State Government from
any persons with respect to the said proposal before the expiry of period specified above will
be considered by the State Government. Objections or suggestion may be addressed to the
Deputy Commissioner, Chikkballapura district.

of the table shall be declared as habitation area of Marimakalahalli village of Gauribidanur

the boundary of Marimakalahalli Revenue village and same will be named as part of
original gramatana extent of Marimakalahalli village Gauribidanur Taluk,
Chikkaballpura District.

FINAL NOTIFICATION

Whereas the draft of the Notification No. RD 50 GLH 2022Dated:04-07-2022
regarding altering the limits of Tejuru village of Holenarasipura Taluk and Hassan
District and constituting a new revenue village called Shettarakoppalu was published
as required by section 6 of the Karnataka Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act
No.12 of 1964) in the Karanataka Gazette No RD 50 GLH 2022Dated:19-07-2022
inviting objections or suggestions from all the persons likely to be affected thereby
within thirty days from the date of its publication in the Official Gazette.

And whereas, the said gazette was made available to the public on Dated:
10-22-2023 And whereas, objections and suggestions have been received and
considered by the State Government;

Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of Karnataka
Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) the Government of Karnataka
here by makes the following notification, namely:-

SCHEDULE-1

Land bearing survey numbers of the village and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of said
Tejuru village of Holenarasipura taluk in Hassan District to form a new revenue
village called Shettarakoppalu of Holenarasipura Taluk and Hassan district along
with survey numbers included in column (4) thereof.

PRELIMINARY NOTIFICATION
In exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of the Karnataka land Revenue
Act, 1964 (Karnataka Act 12 at 1964) and taking into consideration the factors
specified in clauses (i)to (iv) of rule 3 of the Karnataka land Revenue Rules 1966 such
as the population, area under land revenue and having regard to the administrative
convenience, the Government of Karnataka proposes to the alter the extent of

residential area by adding an area occupied by unrecorded habitation within the
boundary of Y.T.Honnatti Village of Ranebennur Taluk of Haveri District to
convert the existing Sevanagar unrecorded habitation in to a hamlet/extention /part of
the existing revenue village. The area occupied by the said hamlet of the village is
specified in the schedule below.
Notification is hereby issued that Land bearing survey numbers and extent
specified in Schedule shall be declared as habitation area within the Boundary of
Y.T.Honnatti village for conversion of Sevanagar unrecorded habitation in to
hamlet/extention /part of the said revenue village.
Now therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by Section 6 of the said Act,
notice is hereby given for the information of all the person likely to be affected thereby
that the proposal will be taken into consideration after thirty days from the date of
publication of the notification in the official Gazette.
Any objection or suggestion which may be received by the State Government
from any persons with respect to the said proposal before the expiry of the period
specified above will be considered by the State Government Objections or suggestions
may be addressed to the Deputy Commissioner of Haveri district.
SCHEDULE
Lands bearing survey numbers and extent speacified below in column (3) of the
tabe shall be declared as habitation area of Sevanagar village of Ranebennur taluk of
Haveri distict and convert the same to form hamlet/extention within the boundary of
Y.T.Honnatti revenue village and same will herein after be named as Sevanagar of
Y.T.Honnatti village Ranebennur taluk and Haveri district.

Multi Storied Building,
Bengaluru. Date:07-03-2023

PRELIMINARY NOTIFICATION
In exercise of the powers conferred by Section 5 of the Karnataka Land Revenue
Act, 1964 (Karnataka act no 12 of 1964) and taking into consideration the factors
specified in clause (i) to (iv) of rule 3 of the Karnataka Land Revenue Rules 1966 such
as the population , area under land revenue and having regard to the administrative
convenience, the Government of Karnataka proposes to alter the extent of residential
area by adding an area occupied by unrecorded habitation within the boundary of
Mandikal village in Mandikal Hobli of Chikkaballapura Taluk, Chikkaballapura
District to extend the original gramatana extent of the existing revenue village. The
area occupied by the said village is specified in the schedule below.
Notification is hereby issued that Land bearing survey numbers and extent
specified in schedule shall be declared as habitation area within the boundary of
Mandikal village for extension of original gramatana extent of the said revenue
village.
Now therefore in exercise of the powers conferred by section 6 of the said Act,
notice is hereby given for the information of all the persons likely to be affected
thereby that the proposal will be taken into consideration after thirty days from the
date of publication of the notification in the official Gazette.
Any objection or suggestion which may be received by the State Government
from any persons with respect to the said proposal before the expiry of period
specified above will be considered by the State Government. Objections or suggestion
may be addressed to the Deputy Commissioner, Chikkballapura district.

SCHEDULE
Land bearing survey numbers in column (2) and extent specified below in
column(3) of the table shall be declared as habitation area of Mandikal village of
Chikkaballpura taluk of Chikkaballpura district and convert the same to form
habitation extension within the boundary of Mandikal Revenue village and same will
be named as part of original gramatana extent of Mandikal village Chikkaballpura
Taluk, Chikkaballpura District.
